subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Location and GPS Testing
description: Learn Location and GPS Testing in one minute.

hook.text: A delivery app shows the driver at the restaurant. In reality, the GPS drifted and the driver is a block away.

buildup.text: GPS accuracy varies by device, environment, and signal strength. Indoor locations are notoriously imprecise.

discovery.text: Mock location tools simulate coordinates, movement speed, altitude, and accuracy levels for testing.

twist.text: Testing must cover GPS denial, low accuracy, rapid location changes, and the transition from GPS to Wi-Fi.

climax.text: Simulating low GPS accuracy reveals the app draws impossible routes. Adding accuracy filtering smooths the path.

punchline.text: GPS lies sometimes. Test your app's tolerance for inaccuracy.

quiz.question: Why use mock location tools in testing?
options: To simulate GPS coordinates, accuracy, and movement scenarios
